kurz: A project stands on its own: its own agents, rules, tasks and documents. The only thing you create by hand is the project folder – AMW does the rest.
brauchst: Projects can only be created at the PC (Workbench on the computer running AMW). Here you can read the steps.

schritte.text: In Explorer, e.g. F:\webshop. The agents work in it (usually the repository). A folder belongs to exactly one project.
Workbench at the PC › project switcher at the top of the navigation › “+ New project” (also under Settings › Project).

Name, project folder, lead (empty if you lead yourself), agents, permissions, rule set (the shipped base rule set – tick and adjust single rules –, a copy of another project, or none) and colour. “Create” sets up the folder (hooks, project id, amw command without confirmation), creates lead and agents with a profile and start prompt and writes a start script of its own.

schritte.titel: Before the first start: mission and first task
schritte.text: “Go to project” › Planning › Mission: goal, non-goals, principles. Then a first task (Work) or an arc (Planning) – otherwise the agent finds nothing to do. Project knowledge (tech, build, style) goes into a CLAUDE.md in the project folder; AMW does not create one.

bilder.name: np-leitbild
bilder.alt: Before the first start: mission and first task

schritte.text: Home › agent tile › “Start”. A tab “CC1 · project name” opens. On the very first start in a new folder Claude Code asks once whether you trust the folder – confirm with “Yes, proceed” in the tab; nothing runs before that. Then the window says “AMW: als CC1 angemeldet”.
The agent reads rules and messages, fetches its work and reports. You see its messages on Home, in History and on its tile (Conversation).

fragen: How does the first agent know everything?

Start prompt – the first sentence of every new session, in the agent's profile (tile › Profile, editable there): who it is, how it calls AMW and what to start with (lead: plan and distribute, agent: fetch work). Mandatory context – on every start, resume and compaction the start hook gives it: command and short guide, goal, non-goals and principles from the mission, active arcs, its task list, open messages and rules. Project knowledge – Claude Code reads your CLAUDE.md in the project folder by itself.
Does a new project need MCP?

No. Agents work through the hooks and the amw command; “Create” sets up both in the project folder. Only a lead without direct access (e.g. in Cowork or a VM) uses the file bridge: Settings › This PC › bridge on; commands in eingang-<project>\befehle in the AMW folder, read copy daten\lesen-<project>.db – the AMW folder must be connected in the desktop app.
Do I have to copy the watcher?
No. One watcher per PC wakes the agents of each project separately. Do not create a second AMW installation.
What do I create by hand?
Only the project folder (and, if you like, a CLAUDE.md in it). AMW creates project, agents, profiles, hooks and start script.
Do I need a Git repository?
Not for AMW. Recommended for code: an agent closes tasks with evidence – a commit, file:line or a follow-up task.
Where are the Claude Code sessions?
The agents work in the project folder. Claude Code keeps the history in your user folder under .claude\projects, per folder. In the Workbench: tile › Conversation.
May the agents have the same names as in the other project?
Yes, CC1 may exist in every project. The tab is then called “CC1 · project name”; each session registers only in its own project.
Move a project to another computer?
amw sichern --projekt <name> writes the project as a database of its own including documents (guide “Several projects” in the docs).
